scenarios.name: scheduled_task_persistence
scenarios.description: Real capture: schtasks.exe /Create registers a daily task whose action is a hidden PowerShell that decodes and runs a payload stored in a registry value.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local: process schtasks.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the task's action is a hidden (T1564.003) PowerShell (T1059.001) that decodes (T1140) a payload kept in a registry value (T1027, T1112).
